HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/8743 (I've updated the renewal close date to 2026-04-15 and added the risk tags.)

- RevOps confirms the Feb ingestion double-count on our ingestion pipeline; we will provide logs by Monday noon to help Finance reconcile.
- We can do the smoke test window on Tue 03/23 10:00am PT. Please share runbook and expected requests per minute so our SRE can provision the window.

Without a stronger mitigation commitment, this appears as a "High" renewal risk on our side.

Happy to discuss during the pre-QBR sync; our RevOps and SRE will join.
